The main takeaway from our work is that
, in a wide class of charged rotating black hole solutions, the entropy product can be expressed as a universal function of the charges and/or angular momenta.
the product of the entropy of all horizons is a highly constrained quantity, which can be expressed in terms of a small number of parameters, which are themselves quantized.
